chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning vs Xue Hongyi: The Immortal Treasure Race — Desolate Era Chapter 264
chapter_meta_description: Xue Hongyi seizes an Immortal-ranked treasure right under Ji Ning’s nose, while Shao Yanong’s predatory gaze turns toward Yu Wei and Nine Lotos.
og_title: Who Gets the Immortal Treasure? Xue Hongyi’s Desperate Grab!
og_description: Xue Hongyi burns a forbidden technique to claim the Azure-Silk Divine Fire Lamp—but Shao Yanong has his eyes on something far more valuable.
twitter_title: Xue Hongyi snags an Immortal-ranked treasure while Shao Yanong zeroes in on Yu Wei.
twitter_description: The treasure palace is rocked by an Immortal-ranked artifact, but the real threat is the Young Master’s entitlement. #DesolateEra

lore_anchors.definition: An artifact of extraordinary power, capable of generating a sentient artifact spirit that can speak and resist unwanted owners. Far beyond Heaven-ranked treasures, they are normally only fully wielded by Celestial Immortals.
The refined essence of cosmic energy, used as the universal high-value currency among cultivators in the Grand Xia Dynasty. 3 million catties is enough to outfit a small army of Wanxiang Adepts.
An Immortal-ranked treasure that can nurture Heavenly Flame to the third grade and unleash Azure-Silk Divine Fire in combat, posing a serious threat to Loose Immortals and Earth Immortals.
A rare, high-destructive flame sought by cultivators; can be nurtured and upgraded through special treasures like the Azure-Silk Divine Fire Lamp.
Shao Yanong’s loyal retainer, a Fiendgod powerhouse who speaks little but moves with savage precision.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Xue Hongyi simply grab the lamp?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The lamp is an Immortal-ranked treasure with an active artifact spirit. It resists being captured by anyone it deems unworthy, forcing Xue Hongyi to use a forbidden technique to overpower it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Battle of Fame in Xianxia?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a pivotal fight where an up-and-coming cultivator clashes with an established powerhouse and survives, effectively announcing their arrival as a major figure regardless of whether they win or lose.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Azure-Silk Divine Fire Lamp useful in combat?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. It can unleash Azure-Silk Divine Fire, which is deadly to Loose Immortals and Earth Immortals, though it is less effective against full Celestial Immortals.
